extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Digestive system organs — the digestive tract is a long tube: mouth (teeth chew, saliva wets food, tongue pushes food back), oesophagus/food pipe (pushes food down by squeezing motion called peristalsis), stomach (muscular bag, churns food with digestive juices and acid, kills germs), small intestine (long coiled tube, main place where nutrients are absorbed into blood, lined with villi for absorption, liver sends bile here to digest fats), large intestine (wider and shorter, absorbs water from leftover waste), rectum (stores waste), anus (waste leaves body). (2) Functions of digestive organs — mouth: chew and mix with saliva (saliva begins breaking down starch). Oesophagus: pushes food down by peristalsis. Stomach: churns with acid and juices (begins protein digestion, kills germs). Small intestine: absorbs nutrients into blood (villi increase surface area). Liver: produces bile (breaks fats into droplets). Large intestine: absorbs water from waste. Chewing food well is important because small pieces digest faster. (3) Excretory system — excretion removes waste from body. Kidneys (two bean-shaped organs at back of abdomen) filter blood and make urine. Ureters (narrow tubes) carry urine from kidneys to bladder. Urinary bladder (muscular bag) stores urine. Urethra (short tube) passes urine out. Skin also helps excretion by producing sweat (removes excess water and salts). Keep system healthy: drink plenty of water, eat fibre-rich food, visit doctor regularly. Misconceptions: 'digestion happens only in the stomach' (digestion begins in the mouth where saliva breaks down starch), 'the liver digests food directly' (the liver produces bile which HELPS digest fats, it does not digest food itself), 'kidneys make urine from food directly' (kidneys filter BLOOD and remove waste as urine, they do not process food directly), 'sweating is just water loss' (sweating is a form of excretion — it removes excess water AND salts from the body), 'the large intestine absorbs nutrients' (the large intestine absorbs WATER, the SMALL intestine absorbs nutrients). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function DigestionGame), NOT export default. Export interface DigestionGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
